user.title: Brottsplatskartan
user.description: Choose the county to fetch incidents for. The next step lets you narrow it down to a municipality or a district.

data_description.area: The API only accepts whole counties. Filtering to a municipality happens in the next step.

places.title: Narrow it down
places.description:
Municipalities reporting incidents in {area} right now: {found}.

Leave the field empty to count the whole county. You can also type a district or neighbourhood by hand, for example Kungsholmen or Södermalm — anything the API names as part of a location will match.

data_description.municipalities: Matching ignores case and the kommun/stad suffixes. Comparison is exact, so a street called Stockholmsvägen in Nacka does not count as Stockholm.
data_description.hours: A rolling window, so the count does not reset at midnight.
data_description.update_interval: The API rate-limits per installation; five minutes is the lowest allowed.
data_description.max_attribute_incidents: How many incidents to put in the sensor's attributes for dashboard cards. 0 omits the list.
data_description.max_markers: A wide window over a whole county can return hundreds of incidents. The newest are kept. 0 means no cap.
data_description.max_pages: Safety stop for pagination. Raise it if a long time window looks truncated.

abort.already_configured: That county and municipality combination is already set up.

error.rate_limited: brottsplatskartan.se is rate limiting this installation. Try again later.

init.title: Brottsplatskartan options
init.description: Watching {area}. Changes apply immediately — no restart needed.

data_description.municipalities: Leave empty for the whole county. Districts can be typed by hand.

data_description.update_interval: Minimum five minutes, to stay inside the API's rate limit.
data_description.max_attribute_incidents: 0 omits the incident list from the sensor's attributes.
